documents.text: Claim denied for two stated reasons: service not medically necessary, and documentation incomplete. Conflicting denial reasons require compliance review before appeal.
Requesting approval for home nursing visits. Patient has complex wound care needs requiring licensed nursing.
Physician notes indicate wound care is necessary. No functional assessment completed since 02/01/2026. Payer criteria requires assessment within 60 days. Assessment overdue as of submission date.

retrieved_policy_sections: Conflicting denial reasons: escalate to compliance review before acting.
Functional assessment if last assessment older than 60 days.
